thread:
james (AE): Heads up — HelixCare wants a short POC for SSO + SCIM. Must haves: SAML 2.0, SCIM delta, support for Azure AD provisioning, group->role mapping, and tenant separation by DNS-verified subdomain. They also flagged BYOK as potential later ask. Can we run a quick alignment?

leah (SE): I can jump on a 20m sync. For Azure AD we should verify attribute mapping for `onPremisesImmutableId` vs email. Also confirm if they'll need SCIM bulk for an initial import.

omar (Security): Audit asks: 2 years retention for auth logs, SCIM change history, support for signed SAML requests, and ability to enforce MFA via IdP. They also want evidence of encryption in transit + at rest and KMS controls.

zoe (Solutions): Sample SCIM mapping snippet for Azure AD: ```json
{
  "mapping": {
    "userName": "userPrincipalName",
    "displayName": "displayName",
    "groups": "memberOf",
    "tenantId": "extension_OrgTenantId"
  }
}
```

james (AE): Pricing: does Azure AD + SCIM require Dedicated? They're a mid-market group, not sure about committed spend.

leah (SE): Hosted enterprise supports standard SCIM. We can do an initial import job as a one-off for the POC; sustained bulk provisioning and guaranteed throughput are Dedicated features.

ops-bot: Note: test-provisioning environment will be recycled in 48h unless extended. Request extension via #eng-infra.

omar (Security): If they push BYOK we escalate to Private. I'll draft which questionnaire answers require Private. Also request their SOC2 report and any encryption policy docs.

zoe (Solutions): SAML metadata to give them: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://helix.redwood.example/sp\">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Location=\"https://helix.redwood.example/saml/acs\" Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

leah (SE): Action items: 1) @zoe send SCIM mapping and sample metadata 2) @omar mark BYOK and extended retention as blockers 3) @james schedule pre-call with IdP admin 4) I'll request a temporary rate-limit bump for POC.

james (AE): Thanks team. I'll include the security questionnaire in the invite and ask for their IdP admin to join. :thumbsup:
